# CloudTalk Help Center

> CloudTalk developer documentation — REST API reference and integration guides.

- [Help Center (457 pages)](https://help.cloudtalk.io/_llms/en/help-center.txt): Documentation for Help Center.
- [API (140 pages)](https://help.cloudtalk.io/_llms/en/api.txt): Documentation for API.

## Webhooks

### Getting Started

- [CloudTalk Webhooks](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/overview.md): CloudTalk webhooks push real-time events (calls, contacts, users, messages, and AI insights) to your HTTPS endpoint as signed JSON, so you can react without polling.
- [How to Verify CloudTalk Webhook Signatures](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/verify-signatures.md): Every account-level CloudTalk webhook is signed with HMAC-SHA256. Learn how to verify the svix-id, svix-timestamp, and svix-signature headers with a library or manually.
- [CloudTalk Webhook Delivery, Retries, and Best Practices](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/delivery.md): How CloudTalk delivers webhooks: success criteria, the retry schedule, automatic endpoint disabling, duplicate handling, ordering, and best practices for reliable handlers.
- [Manage webhooks with the API](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/manage-with-api.md): Create, update and delete webhook endpoints, read and rotate signing secrets, send test events and inspect deliveries from the CloudTalk API instead of the Dashboard.

### Events

- [Call Webhook Events: Payloads for the call.* Triggers](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/calls.md): Reference for CloudTalk's call webhook events (call.started, call.ringing, call.answered, call.held, call.resumed, call.ended, call.recording_ready, call.completed, and call.tags_modified) with example payloads and field definitions.
- [Contact Webhook Events: Payloads for the contact.* Triggers](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/contacts.md): Reference for CloudTalk's contact webhook events (contact.created, contact.updated, and contact.deleted) with example payloads and field definitions.
- [User Webhook Events: Payloads for the user.* Triggers](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/users.md): Reference for CloudTalk's user webhook events (user.created, user.updated, user.deleted, and user.status_changed) with example payloads and field definitions.
- [Message Webhook Events: Payloads for the message.* Triggers](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/messages.md): Reference for CloudTalk's message webhook events (message.sent, message.received and message.delivery_updated) with example payloads and field definitions for SMS, MMS, and WhatsApp.
- [Conversation Intelligence Webhook Events: Transcripts and AI Analysis](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/conversation-intelligence.md): Reference for CloudTalk's Conversation Intelligence webhook events (transcript.ready and cidata.ready) with example payloads covering transcripts, summaries, sentiment, topics, talk ratio, and call scoring.
- [AI Voice Agent Webhook Events: Extracted Data Payloads](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/voice-agents.md): Reference for CloudTalk's AI Voice Agent webhook event (voice_agent.extracted_data_ready) with an example payload and field definitions.
- [Dialer Webhook Events: Dispositions and Survey Responses](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/webhooks/events/dialer.md): Reference for CloudTalk's Dialer webhook events (dialer.disposition_created and dialer.survey_filled) with example payloads and field definitions.

## MCP

- [CloudTalk MCP](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/mcp/overview.md): The CloudTalk MCP server connects Claude, Cursor, and other AI assistants to your CloudTalk account: search calls, read transcripts, manage contacts, send SMS, and run AI Voice Agents in natural language.
- [Quickstart: Connect Your AI Assistant to CloudTalk](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/mcp/quickstart.md): Connect Claude, Cursor, or any MCP-compatible client to the CloudTalk MCP server in five minutes, by signing in with your CloudTalk account or with an API Access Key.
- [MCP Recipes](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/mcp/recipes.md): Ready-to-use prompts for getting real work done with CloudTalk through Claude, Cursor, or any MCP client. Copy, paste, adapt.
- [CloudTalk MCP Tool Reference](https://help.cloudtalk.io/guides/mcp/tools.md): Every tool the CloudTalk MCP server exposes: parameters, defaults, and limits across calls, contacts, messaging, AI Voice Agents, campaigns, and account data.
